planets.name: TOI-1685 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1685 with a 0.669-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-1685 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1685. Its orbit and size follow Egger et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname EGGER_ET_AL__2025): disc_year 2021, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 0.66913856, pl_radj 0.12677335, pl_bmassj 0.0096593

quotes.title: TOI-1685 b
quotes.card: TOI-1685 b is a terrestrial super-Earth that orbits around the red dwarf star TOI-1685 which is located around 122.6 light years from Earth.
quotes.introduction: It is a hot and barren planet with a mass of about 3 Earths and a radius of 1.4 Earths.
